direct_strict_certificate_finding: For EVERY finite actual-corner strictly-negative-coordinate atom certificate on an eligible septic box, some E-root band and some disjoint O-root band must each contain a backwards time-ordered crossing. If a reversed band is its parity's odd-numbered root, the earlier node must include an atom using the lower parity endpoint and the later node one using the upper endpoint; for an even-numbered root the orientations reverse. Repeated-frequency averages are handled with at-least-one constituent corner of each indicated orientation. This directly constrains genuine strict certificates with any number of atoms, not a zero-annihilator encoding.
